candidate_state: released from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.results: The release-mode USI binary built from the preparation commit and answered usiok and readyok. Workspace tests, Clippy, formatting, tagged WASM package provenance and local npm preflight checks passed. This is not a playing-strength measurement.

external_opponents.configuration: No external opponent, evaluator, weights, labels, or derived positions were used to select this release.

known_limitations: The GitHub Release asset remains the primary distribution; the npm registry outcome is recorded separately in webassembly.npm_registry_status.
Source commit and version identify source provenance, not distributed byte identity or playing strength.
Optional nn_r6 weights remain separate from the WASM package and are available from the v0.5.0 GitHub Release; this release does not select a new checkpoint.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
